description: This file defines the RegisterScreen for a Flutter app, implementing user registration UI and logic, utilizing Riverpod for state management, GoRouter for navigation, and custom widgets for input fields and buttons.

classes.name: RegisterScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing the registration screen, allowing users to input name, email, password, and submit registration request.

classes.name: _RegisterScreenState
classes.description: State class for RegisterScreen managing form state, text controllers, visibility toggle, and submission logic.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for RegisterScreen.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers when widget is removed.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles form validation, triggers registration via authControllerProvider, and navigates or shows errors accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the registration UI, including form fields, buttons, and layout.
